title: One-tape sweep machine construction
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet with decidable equality, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$ with $k$ work tapes, and choose a symbol $a_0\in\Gamma$. The definition specifies a finite Turing machine over the enlarged sweep alphabet, with one work tape and state set $\mathrm{DGState}(\Gamma,M.\mathrm{State},k)$; its transition function encodes the input and work-tape actions of $M$ and uses sweep states to update the encoded tapes and boundary markers.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over $\Gamma$ with $k$ work tapes
